sections.details: Guidelines for autopsy investigation of sudden cardiac death. The importance of genetic testing in autopsy-negative cases. Various studies discuss the outcomes of molecular autopsy in sudden unexplained death and the role of cardiovascular disease genetics.
Advanced health planning and patient preference considerations regarding implantable cardioverter-defibrillators.
Focuses on decision-making processes involving implantable cardioverter-defibrillators, incorporating patient preferences and perceptions.

genes.context: Genetic testing for inherited cardiac disease. Molecular autopsy to identify mutations such as SCN5A in cases of sudden unexplained death.
